title: Bounded configuration semantics
statement: For a natural number $E$, an oracle $\mathrm{orc}:\mathrm{Fin}(4)\to\mathrm{List}(\mathrm{Bool})\to\mathrm{Bool}$, an input $x\in\mathrm{List}(\mathrm{Bool})$, a natural-number bound $B$, a state label $l\in\mathrm{GLb}(E)$, a register state $\sigma$, and a proposition $P$, the predicate holds exactly when the nondeterministic semantics of the machine parameterized by $E$, with oracle $\mathrm{orc}$ and register bound $\mathrm{RegLe}(17,\mathrm{GLb}(E),B)$, assigns $P$ to the initial configuration with control state $l$, register vector $\sigma$, and no output.
caveat: The payload does not define the machine semantics, register bound, or register-vector construction, so their operational meanings cannot be stated more explicitly while remaining faithful to the supplied definition.
